hero.subtitle: Predict all 104 matches of the 2026 World Cup with your group of friends, your team or your whole company.

how.title: Join, predict, compare, win
how.intro: A World Cup pool with friends — no spreadsheets, no WhatsApp groups full of screenshots: the app saves your predictions, scores the points in real time and shows the leaderboard at every moment of the tournament.
how.step1Text: Create your private pool and share the 4-digit code, or join with your friends' code.
how.step2Text: Depending on your pool's mode: in Full, group standings, FIFA bracket, Golden Boot and the score + scorer of each match; in Score, just the scoreline; in Winner Only, just the winner.
how.step3Text: As the matches are played, points are added instantly. The leaderboard updates live.
how.step4Text: Whoever reads the tournament best wins. Bragging rights, a symbolic league trophy, or whatever the players agree on.

modes.title: Choose how deep you want to go
modes.intro: Every pool has a prediction mode — from the most complete to the fastest. You pick it when you create yours, or jump straight into the public pool for each mode. Each mode has its own leaderboard.

empresas.title: The office ritual of the World Cup
empresas.intro: Three weeks with your team glued to the leaderboard, talking through the matches in the internal chat and competing between departments. No spreadsheets, no WhatsApp groups, no renewals. One payment for the whole tournament.
empresas.feat1Text: Marketing, Sales, Engineering… competing on points average. A team of 8 can beat one of 20.
empresas.feat2Text: Covers June 11 to July 19. No subscription, no later charges.
empresas.feat3Text: Three sizes so small teams or large rosters fit — scale up without migrating data.
empresas.feat4Text: Corporate branding in the header, exportable leaderboard and a direct email reply during the tournament.

tournament.title: First edition with 48 teams
tournament.intro: The 2026 World Cup debuts a new format: 12 groups of four teams; the top 2 + the 8 best third-placed sides advance to a new round of 32. Then: round of 16, quarters, semis and the final on July 19 in New York-NJ. A total of 104 matches in 39 days across the United States, Canada and Mexico.

news.title: Squads, previews and everything World Cup
news.intro: The latest from the 48 teams, last-minute injuries, previews with probable line-ups and match-by-match reports. Updated daily during the tournament.

explore.title: The whole 2026 World Cup, organized
explore.intro: Full schedule, the 12 groups, the FIFA bracket all the way to the final, the top scorers table, the 48 teams and the 16 venues. All the info in the open, no sign-up.
explore.calendarText: All 104 matches of the 2026 World Cup sorted by date and matchday.
explore.groupsText: The four teams in each group and their head-to-head matches.
explore.bracketText: The FIFA bracket: round of 32, round of 16, quarters, semis and final.
explore.scorersText: The race for the 2026 Golden Boot, updated match by match.
explore.teamsText: Full squad of every team qualified for the 2026 World Cup.
explore.venuesText: Stadiums and cities in the United States, Canada and Mexico hosting the tournament.

categories.title: Six ways to score points
categories.intro: The game isn't just about scorelines. You combine long-term predictions (groups, bracket, tournament top scorer) with more immediate ones (exact score and scorer of each match).
categories.groupText: You rank the 4 teams in each of the 12 groups. Locks at the start of the tournament.
categories.bracketText: Round of 32, round of 16, quarters, semis and final. Predict the whole bracket and the champion.
categories.scorerText: Your Golden Boot. If your player ends up as top scorer, a bonus set of points.
categories.matchScoreText: Predict the exact result of each match. Bonus for getting score and winner right.
categories.matchScorerText: Pick who scores in each of the 104 matches.
categories.specialsText: Questions like 'will there be a penalty shootout in the quarters?'. Surprises that count.

faqs.a1: You join a pool (the public one or a private one with a 4-digit code) and predict according to its game mode. In Full mode: the standings of the 12 groups, the full bracket, the scorers, the score of each match and special predictions. In Score: just the exact score of each match. In Winner Only: just who wins each match. You earn points as you get them right, with overall and per-league leaderboards.
faqs.a2: Three, and you choose whichever you like when you create your pool (each mode also has its own public pool). Full: the entire experience — group standings, FIFA bracket, Golden Boot, specials and score + scorer of each match. Score: just the exact score of each match, simple and direct. Winner Only: just who wins each match (or a draw), the fastest to fill in, ideal for large groups or people with little time.
faqs.q3: Is it free to make a pool?
faqs.a3: Yes, up to 20 members per private pool. You can create up to 5 private pools for free with your friends and always take part in the Public Pool. For companies or larger groups (50, 100 or 250 members), we have 2026 World Cup Passes from €19 — see /precios.
faqs.q4: Are there plans for companies and large groups?
faqs.a4: Yes. The Standard version supports up to 20 members per pool, for free. For companies, communities or events with more people there are 2026 World Cup Passes that scale the league to 50, 100 or 250 members. One payment per tournament. Details at /precios.
faqs.q5: Is there an app for iPhone and Android?
faqs.a5: It works as a Progressive Web App: from Safari (iPhone/iPad) or Chrome (Android) you can 'Add to Home Screen' and it behaves like a native app, full screen and with its own icon.
faqs.q6: When and where is the 2026 World Cup played?
faqs.a6: From June 11 to July 19, 2026 in the United States, Canada and Mexico. It's the first edition with 48 teams, 12 groups, 104 matches and 16 venues across the three host countries.
faqs.q7: How do I join my friends' pool?
faqs.a7: Ask the creator for the 4-digit code or the invite link. Enter it on the join screen and you're in instantly. Each user can belong to the public pool plus 5 private pools.
faqs.q8: Can I change my prediction afterwards?
faqs.a8: Yes, as long as the matchday or stage hasn't closed. Each category has its deadline (the group stage closes at the kickoff of the matchday's first match; scores close at the start of each match).
faqs.q9: Who runs the tournament and publishes the matches?
faqs.a9: The 2026 World Cup is organized by FIFA. This site is not affiliated — it's just a predictions tool. All schedule, group and venue information reflects the official programming published by FIFA.
faqs.q10: How many private pools can I create or join?
faqs.a10: Up to 5 private pools per user, plus the Public Pool (always active). You can be the creator of some and just a participant in others; each with its own leaderboard.

ctaFinal.title: Your World Cup pool is one click away
ctaFinal.text: Create yours, share the code with your people and let the battle begin.

about.title: The collaborative 2026 World Cup pool
about.p1: Quiniela Mundial 2026 is the platform to play your 2026 World Cup pool with your group. You choose whether to compete with the community in the Public Pool or to create a private one with your friends, your team or your whole company. You predict scores, scorers, group standings, the bracket and a handful of special questions — all in the same app, with no spreadsheets or WhatsApp groups full of screenshots.
about.p2: Whether it's the office pool, the sweepstake with friends or the bracket with your mates, Quiniela Mundial 2026 works the same: one product, you choose the name — the collaborative experience and the points mechanics, identical.
about.p3: Creating a pool on <home>Quiniela Mundial 2026</home> is free up to 20 members. For companies, communities or events with large groups there are <pricing>2026 World Cup Passes</pricing> from €19 (one payment, no subscription) that scale the league up to 50, 100 or 250 members with corporate logo, pinned announcement and CSV export.
